meta.title: The Vault Job
meta.subject: teamwork
meta.author: mission_architect
meta.design_note: Designed for 1-2 player sessions. Hub draws only from connected archetypes at runtime. Full 8-archetype pools included for any-tablet compatibility.

direct.label: Left into the alley!
direct.narrator_line: Wheelman! Left into the alley — cops on the main road!

direct.label: Right — over the bridge!
direct.narrator_line: Right! Over the bridge — lose them in the district!

direct.label: Floor it — straight ahead!
direct.narrator_line: Floor it! Straight ahead — punch through!

direct.label: REVERSE! Spin and go!
direct.narrator_line: Reverse! J-turn — spin it and GO!

direct.label: Full throttle!
direct.narrator_line: Wheelman! Full throttle — we need speed!

direct.label: Ease off — half speed!
direct.narrator_line: Half speed — blend in with traffic!

direct.label: Cut speed — coast!
direct.narrator_line: Coast! Engine down — we're drawing attention!

direct.label: Signal left — change lanes!
direct.narrator_line: Signal left! Change lanes now!

direct.label: Cancel left turn!
direct.narrator_line: Cancel that! Straight — straight!

direct.label: Signal right — NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Right turn signal! Take the ramp!

direct.label: Cancel right!
direct.narrator_line: Abort the turn! Stay on the highway!

direct.label: Hazard lights — ON!
direct.narrator_line: Hazard blinkers on! Pull over act — blend in!

direct.label: Kill the hazards!
direct.narrator_line: Hazards off — we're moving again!

direct.label: HIT THE GAS!
direct.narrator_line: Hit the gas! GO GO GO!

direct.label: Burnout — smoke screen!
direct.narrator_line: Burnout! Lay down rubber — smoke screen!

direct.label: Drill to maximum RPM!
direct.narrator_line: Safecracker! Max drill — bore through that plate!

direct.label: Drill to half — easy!
direct.narrator_line: Half RPM — easy now, you'll snap the bit!

direct.label: Low RPM — precision!
direct.narrator_line: Low drill — precision work on the tumbler!

direct.label: Kill the drill!
direct.narrator_line: Kill the drill — guard's coming past!

direct.label: Patch: main alarm bypass!
direct.narrator_line: Safecracker! Wire the main alarm bypass!

direct.label: Patch: backup circuit!
direct.narrator_line: Backup circuit — swap those wires!

direct.label: Patch: vault door wires!
direct.narrator_line: Vault door wiring — reroute those jacks NOW!

direct.label: Pop the lock!
direct.narrator_line: Safecracker! Pop that lock — we need in!

direct.label: CUT the red wire!
direct.narrator_line: Cut the red wire! Disarm the alarm!

direct.label: Splice the red wire back!
direct.narrator_line: Splice the red wire back — they're testing the circuit!

direct.label: CUT the blue wire!
direct.narrator_line: Blue wire! Cut the blue one — NOT the red!

direct.label: Splice the blue wire back!
direct.narrator_line: Splice blue back — it's a decoy line!

direct.label: Torch through the bars!
direct.narrator_line: Torch the bars! Burn through — we need access!

direct.label: Kill the torch — sparks!
direct.narrator_line: Kill the torch — sparks are setting off sensors!

direct.label: Police band: frequency 142!
direct.narrator_line: Comms! Tune to one-four-two — police dispatch!

direct.label: Our channel: frequency 88!
direct.narrator_line: Back to our channel — eighty-eight! Check in!

direct.label: Security band: freq 200!
direct.narrator_line: Frequency two hundred — that's the vault's security!

direct.label: Backup channel: freq 50!
direct.narrator_line: Switch to backup — frequency fifty! Primary's compromised!

direct.label: Enter scramble code 7-7-3-4!
direct.narrator_line: Comms! Scramble code seven-seven-three-four — encrypt!

direct.label: Override code: 1-1-9!
direct.narrator_line: Override one-one-nine — unlock the relay!

direct.label: Spoof code: 5-0-5-0!
direct.narrator_line: Spoof code five-zero-five-zero — send it!

direct.label: Jammer ON — kill comms!
direct.narrator_line: Jammer on! Kill their communications!

direct.label: Jammer OFF — we need ears!
direct.narrator_line: Jammer off! We need to hear what they're saying!

direct.label: Spoof the GPS signal!
direct.narrator_line: Spoof their GPS — send them the wrong way!

direct.label: Kill the GPS spoof!
direct.narrator_line: Kill the spoof — they're triangulating us!

direct.label: Squelch the feedback!
direct.narrator_line: Squelch that noise — I can't hear the scanner!

direct.label: Burst transmit — NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Burst transmit! Compressed — send it NOW!

direct.label: Drill pressure — FIRM!
direct.narrator_line: Muscle! Hold the drill pressure at seventy — steady hands!

direct.label: Ease the drill — LIGHT!
direct.narrator_line: Ease off! Drill to thirty — we hit the inner casing!

direct.label: Guard shift: DAY!
direct.narrator_line: Set the guard rotation to day shift — confuse them!

direct.label: Guard shift: NIGHT!
direct.narrator_line: Night shift — position two! Fewer guards on patrol!

direct.label: Shift: LOCKDOWN mode!
direct.narrator_line: Lockdown mode — position three! Buy us time!

direct.label: Open fire escape!
direct.narrator_line: Fire escape — pop the door! Secondary exit!

direct.label: Seal fire escape!
direct.narrator_line: Seal the fire escape — block their route!

direct.label: Open the stairwell!
direct.narrator_line: Stairwell door — open it! We're going up!

direct.label: Lock the stairwell!
direct.narrator_line: Lock the stairwell! Trap them below!

direct.label: FLASHBANG!
direct.narrator_line: Flashbang! Eyes closed — POP!

direct.label: Match GUARD uniform tan!
direct.narrator_line: Disguise! Match the guard uniform — tan!

direct.label: Match JANITOR blue!
direct.narrator_line: Janitor uniform — blue! Quick, someone's coming!

direct.label: Executive suit — BLACK!
direct.narrator_line: Executive disguise — black suit! Walk like you own it!

direct.label: Voice changer to 150!
direct.narrator_line: Voice modulator to one-fifty — sound like the manager!

direct.label: Voice to 80 — natural!
direct.narrator_line: Eighty — keep it natural. Don't oversell it!

direct.label: Voice to 250 — dispatch!
direct.narrator_line: Two-fifty! Sound like dispatch — authoritative!

direct.label: Flash the fake badge!
direct.narrator_line: Flash the badge! Don't let them look too close!

direct.label: Hide the badge!
direct.narrator_line: Stash the badge — wrong department for this floor!

direct.label: Check the mirror!
direct.narrator_line: Mirror check! Make sure the disguise holds!

direct.label: Quick change — NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Quick change! New look — thirty seconds!

direct.label: Hack code: 4-9-2-7!
direct.narrator_line: Hacker! Code four-nine-two-seven — bypass the firewall!

direct.label: Override code: 8-1-3!
direct.narrator_line: Override eight-one-three — kill the motion sensors!

direct.label: Access code: 3-6-0!
direct.narrator_line: Three-six-zero — the vault access code! Punch it in!

direct.label: Firewall: layer THREE!
direct.narrator_line: Firewall selector — layer three! Punch through!

direct.label: Firewall: layer FIVE!
direct.narrator_line: Layer five — the deep firewall! Switch to five!

direct.label: Firewall: layer ONE — sneak!
direct.narrator_line: Layer one — low-band entry! Sneak through!

direct.label: Loop the camera feed!
direct.narrator_line: Loop the cameras — show them yesterday's footage!

direct.label: Restore cameras!
direct.narrator_line: Restore the feed — they're checking for glitches!

direct.label: Spoof the badge system!
direct.narrator_line: Spoof the badge readers — all badges valid!

direct.label: Restore badge system!
direct.narrator_line: Restore badge authentication — don't tip them off!

direct.label: Wipe the access logs!
direct.narrator_line: Wipe the logs! We were never here!

direct.label: Laser grid — scan LEFT!
direct.narrator_line: Recon! Scan the laser grid left — find the gap!

direct.label: Laser grid — scan RIGHT!
direct.narrator_line: Scan right! The pattern shifted — find the opening!

direct.label: Grid gap HIGH — look up!
direct.narrator_line: High gap! Scan up — the top beam cycled off!

direct.label: Low crawl — grid low!
direct.narrator_line: Low! Belly crawl — gap at the bottom!

direct.label: Thermal: match GUARD red!
direct.narrator_line: Recon! Thermal scope — match the guard's heat signature!

direct.label: Thermal: cool BLUE blend!
direct.narrator_line: Cool blue — match the wall temperature! Disappear!

direct.label: Thermal: circuit GREEN!
direct.narrator_line: Green circuit signature — match it to spoof the sensor!

direct.label: Open the vent hatch!
direct.narrator_line: Recon! Pop the vent hatch — go through the ceiling!

direct.label: Close the vent!
direct.narrator_line: Close the vent — hide the trail!

direct.label: Eyes on east wing!
direct.narrator_line: East wing — guard patrol coming! Report!

direct.label: East wing — clear!
direct.narrator_line: East clear — shift your eyes!

direct.label: Check west wing!
direct.narrator_line: West wing clear? Check it — we need that corridor!

direct.label: West wing — clear!
direct.narrator_line: West clear — no patrols on that side!

direct.label: Roof access — check it!
direct.narrator_line: Roof access — is the helicopter pad clear?

direct.label: Patch: infiltration route!
direct.narrator_line: Mastermind! Wire the infiltration routing!

direct.label: Patch: extraction route!
direct.narrator_line: Extraction routing — reroute the jacks!

direct.label: Patch: diversion circuit!
direct.narrator_line: Diversion circuit — swap those wires NOW!

direct.label: Scan the MASTER KEY!
direct.narrator_line: Mastermind! The master key card — scan it!

direct.label: Scan OVERRIDE badge!
direct.narrator_line: Override badge! Scan it — full building access!

direct.label: Confirm — GO!
direct.narrator_line: That's a GO! Execute the plan!

direct.label: Send the abort code!
direct.narrator_line: Abort code! Transmit it — pull everyone out!

direct.label: Clear the abort — resume!
direct.narrator_line: Clear the abort! False alarm — resume operations!

direct.label: All clear signal!
direct.narrator_line: All clear! Send the signal — green light!

direct.label: EVACUATE!
direct.narrator_line: Evac signal! Get to the getaway — NOW!

cooperative.label: Tell Wheels: floor it!
cooperative.narrator_line: Mastermind! Tell the Wheelman — floor it!

cooperative.label: Tell Wheels: full throttle!
cooperative.narrator_line: Safecracker! Shout to Wheels — full throttle!

cooperative.label: Tell Safe: drill to max!
cooperative.narrator_line: Hacker! Tell the Safecracker — max RPM on the drill!

cooperative.label: Tell Safe: half drill!
cooperative.narrator_line: Mastermind! Tell the Safecracker — ease the drill!

cooperative.label: Tell Comms: our channel 88!
cooperative.narrator_line: Recon! Tell Comms — back to eighty-eight!

cooperative.label: Tell Muscle: flashbang!
cooperative.narrator_line: Comms! Tell the Muscle — flashbang NOW!

cooperative.label: Tell Muscle: night shift!
cooperative.narrator_line: Disguise! Tell the Muscle — switch to night shift!

cooperative.label: Tell Disguise: flash badge!
cooperative.narrator_line: Safecracker! Tell Disguise — flash the badge!

cooperative.label: Tell Disguise: quick change!
cooperative.narrator_line: Muscle! Tell Disguise — quick change, NOW!

cooperative.label: Tell Hacker: firewall layer 3!
cooperative.narrator_line: Muscle! Shout to the Hacker — firewall layer three!

cooperative.label: Tell Recon: laser gap left!
cooperative.narrator_line: Hacker! Tell Recon — scan the laser grid left!

cooperative.label: Tell Recon: open the vent!
cooperative.narrator_line: Comms! Tell Recon — pop the vent hatch!

cooperative.label: Tell Boss: patch extraction!
cooperative.narrator_line: Recon! Tell the Mastermind — extraction routing!

cooperative.label: Tell Boss: send abort code!
cooperative.narrator_line: Disguise! Shout to the Mastermind — abort code!

open.label: Someone — dodge LEFT!
open.narrator_line: Anyone with a stick — dodge left! Security beam!

open.label: Anyone — crank to MAX!
open.narrator_line: Whoever has a slider — maximum output NOW!

open.label: Quick — dial to 77!
open.narrator_line: Any dial operator — seventy-seven! Override channel!

open.label: Someone — match WHITE!
open.narrator_line: Anyone with a color dial — bright white! Blind the sensor!

open.label: Anyone — switch to position 2!
open.narrator_line: Whoever has a selector — position two! Fast!

open.label: Someone — code 0-0-7!
open.narrator_line: Anyone with a keypad — code zero-zero-seven! Master bypass!

crises.label: ALARM TRIPPED!
crises.narrator_line: THE ALARM! Everyone — hit your override! SHUT IT DOWN!

crises.label: GUARD PATROL!
crises.narrator_line: GUARDS COMING! Everyone freeze — hit your panic button!

crises.label: POWER SURGE!
crises.narrator_line: POWER SURGE! Hacker — loop cameras! Recon — scan the grid!

crises.label: VAULT LOCKOUT!
crises.narrator_line: VAULT LOCKOUT! Safecracker — drill! Comms — jam the signal!

narrator_lines: Eleven thirty PM. The Grand Continental Vault.
Thirty-seven floors of security. One chance.
The guards change shift in ten minutes. After that, every sensor goes active.
You know the plan. Get in. Get to the vault. Get the package. Get out.
Clock's ticking. Let's go.

phases.narrator_intro: Final gear check. Set your rigs to starting positions. Green light when ready.

narrator_lines_ambient: Through the lobby. Act natural.
Cameras on the left — don't look up.
Service elevator, end of the hall. Move.
Easy. Smooth. Just like we rehearsed.

narrator_lines: Clean entry. Nobody suspects a thing.
We're on the vault floor. Security hub is two doors down.
Sloppy. A guard spotted something. They're reviewing footage.
We still have a window, but it's shrinking. Service tunnels!

narrator_lines_ambient: The vault door. Sixteen-inch steel. Two combination locks.
Work the drill. Match the tumblers.
Guard on the floor above — stay quiet.
Almost through the first lock. Keep going.
Service tunnels. Dark. Tight. Watch for motion sensors.
Extra patrols — someone tipped security.
We have to move faster. The window is closing.
There — the vault access panel. Crack it open!

narrator_lines: The vault is open! Beautiful work.
Grab the package. Now the hard part — getting out alive.
Partial breach — silent alarm triggered. They know we're here.
Package in hand but the building is locking down. Move! NOW!
Side entrance to the vault — the tunnels paid off!
Package secured. They're searching floor by floor. Time to vanish.
Vault panel is scrambled — brute force it!
We're blown. Alarms in ninety seconds. Grab what you can!

narrator_lines_ambient: Extraction! Roof or ground floor — pick a route!
Stairwell clear — go go go!
Wheelman, start the engine. We're coming out hot.
Almost there — don't get cocky now!
Lockdown! Elevators frozen! Stairs only!
Guards on the east wing — cut through the offices!
Wheelman! Be ready — we're coming in hot!
Keep moving. Stop and you're caught.
Back through the service tunnels — our best bet!
They're sweeping the corridors. Stay underground.
Loading dock exit — two hundred metres!
Almost out. Almost out. Don't stop.
ALARMS EVERYWHERE! Full sprint!
Forget stealth — just RUN!
Wheelman! Engine NOW! We're coming through the lobby!
Sirens. Sixty seconds before the cops arrive.

WWW.title: Ghost Job
narrator_lines: Clean getaway. The package is in the car.
You're on the highway before the first siren wails.
By morning, you're three states away. Not a camera caught your face.
The perfect job. Like it never happened.

WWL.title: Hot Exit
narrator_lines: Messy exit, but you made it. Package secure.
The car smells like smoke and adrenaline.
You're free, goods in hand, nobody's in cuffs. That's a win.

WLW.title: Tunnel Rats
narrator_lines: A rough middle act — but the exit was textbook.
The tunnels saved you. Package intact. Team intact.
Not the cleanest job. But it's done.

WLL.title: Laying Low
narrator_lines: You barely made it out. Package in hand but the city's looking.
Switch vehicles. Ditch the comms. Lay low for six months.
Sloppy work. But you're free.

LWW.title: Plan B Worked
narrator_lines: Terrible start. Perfect recovery. The tunnels were the play.
Package secured. Team out clean on the second attempt.
The Mastermind is buying drinks tonight.

LWL.title: New Identities
narrator_lines: Package secured. Also your face — on every camera in the building.
New identities. New city. Was it worth the heat?
Never again. Probably.

LLW.title: Miracle Finish
narrator_lines: A miracle finish. By all rights you should be in cuffs.
Package secured by pure luck and a broken fire escape.
If you ever speak of this job, leave out the middle part.

LLL.title: Busted
narrator_lines: Red and blue lights everywhere. Package dropped. Car blocked.
You scatter on foot. Some make it. The job doesn't.
The Grand Continental Vault remains unbreached.
